rider_offset.frame: pegasus 'saddle' bone frame with the origin at the bone HEAD (Blender bone axes: +Y along the bone = world up at rest; glTF/Godot keep this joint frame). Euler XYZ degrees. Transform of the hercules ROOT (armature origin = between his feet): rider_world = saddle_bone_global @ T(loc) @ R(rot).

rider_offset_armature_axes.frame: same transform, origin at the saddle bone head but in PEGASUS ARMATURE axes (Z up, faces -Y), like pegasus rig.json socket_offsets. With pegasus at rest the rider root sits at saddle_head + loc.

pegasus_pose.notes: ride sheet flight pose: wings half raised (glide + 15 deg up about the body axis, trailing edge pitched up 18 deg) and spread, legs tucked, neck stretched forward, tail streaming back; body level (root untouched)

notes: Poses are ak (animkit) format: apply with tools/ak on each character's own blend (absolute view axes, each armature at the origin). hercules_pose is applied in HIS armature frame; the rider offset then carries the whole body onto the saddle, so his view axes follow pegasus's back (both face -Y when pegasus is level).
Hercules skirt bones are driven (rig.json "driven", skirt_drivers.skirt_matrices): never key them; ak and the GLB export set them from the thighs.

fingers_l / fingers_r: curl of {'fingers_l': 75, 'fingers_r': 75} deg about the finger bone's own X (grip), stored as the equivalent ak local_delta for THIS hand pose; if the hand pose changes, re-derive it (build_ride.py resolve_grip).

The pegasus pose is the first frame of the ride video only (wings half raised); the game uses pegasus fly/glide clips and the hercules ride clip; rider_offset stays valid as long as the saddle bone is used (it rides spine_02).

Rebuild: python3 art_src/chars/ride/scripts/make_poses.py art_src/chars/ride/poses; Blender -b --factory-startup --python art_src/chars/ride/scripts/build_ride.py -- <repo> art_src/chars/ride/seat.json
